snippet.title: Borderlands 4 - Official 'Amara and the Vile Shadows' Bounty Pack 5 Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the 'Amara and the Vile Shadows' Bounty Pack 5 Reveal Trailer for Borderlands 4, the hit first-person action looter shooter developed by Gearbox. Players will join arms with Amara to hunt the Phase disturbances across the known universe and stop them from encroaching any further. Unlock a Vault Hunter Skin and more rewards in the 'Amara and the Vile Shadows' Bounty Pack 5 for Borderlands 4, launching on September 10 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#ign #gaming
